select cu.name contactsUnitName, cu.contact_person contactsUnitContact, sum(ifnull(tadd.registration_count,0)) registrationCount, sum(ifnull(tadd.receive_count,0)) receiveCount from t_contacts_unit cu left join t_material m on cu.id=m.contacts_unit_id and m.del_flag=0 left join t_advance_delivery_detail tadd on m.id=tadd.material_id and tadd.del_flag=0 where cu.del_flag=0
and cu.name like concat('%',#{contactsUnitName},'%')
and cu.contact_person like concat('%',#{contactsUnitContact},'%')
group by cu.id order by cu.id desc

select cu.name contactsUnitName, cu.contact_person contactsUnitContact, sum(ifnull(tadd.registration_count,0)) registrationCount, sum(ifnull(tadd.detection_count,0)) detectionCount, DATE_FORMAT(tadd.create_time, '%Y年%m月') AS month from t_contacts_unit cu left join t_material m on cu.id=m.contacts_unit_id and m.del_flag=0 left join t_advance_delivery_detail tadd on m.id=tadd.material_id and tadd.del_flag=0 where cu.del_flag=0
and cu.name like concat('%',#{contactsUnitName},'%')
and cu.contact_person like concat('%',#{contactsUnitContact},'%')
group by cu.id,month order by cu.id desc

SELECT t2.`code` AS material_code, t2.`name` AS material_name, t3.`name` AS unit_name, t1.batch_code, t1.registration_count, '1' AS detection_fail_type, t1.detection_fail_status, t1.id FROM t_advance_delivery_detail t1 LEFT JOIN t_material t2 ON t1.material_id = t2.id LEFT JOIN t_unit t3 ON t2.unit_id = t3.id WHERE t1.advance_delivery_id = #{value} AND t1.del_flag = '0'
